title: scrumia-rules — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-rules: the rules-hierarchy format for ScrumIA — index, guides, decisions, loaded on demand.
tagline: The rules-hierarchy format itself: index, guides, decisions.
responsibilities: Defines how a body of rules is laid out so an agent loads only the guide a task routes to: an index read first and always, guides opened on demand, decisions opened only when a rule is challenged. Scaffolds a project's own section and evolves a rule without losing why it existed.
refusals: It is not a place to store rules. It owns the shape, never the content, and it declines to arbitrate a rule that belongs to an implementation module.
philosophy: Assumes a body of rules grows past what one file can carry. Costs one more layer to author correctly — below three distinct concerns, a section is pure overhead.
